title: Lecturing Birds on How to Fly
coreMove: Let reality-tested tinkering produce knowledge before demanding a complete theory.
sourcePressure: This chapter argues that practice, tinkering, and contact with reality often precede clean theory in complex domains.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating theory as useless or practitioners as automatically wise.
